name: Acheros
source:
No one in Limbo truly knows who the administrators are or how they came to power, but neither does anyone dare question their authority.

Acheros is one of many administrators responsible for keeping the cogs of Limbo whirring. He is a firm but fair leader who is always eager to welcome new volunteers.
